summary: Colliers International Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its interim consolidated financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the three-month period ended March 31, 2026. The filing reports standard quarterly results, including revenues of $1.31 billion and a net loss attributable to the Company of $24.0 million. There is no mention of any corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a routine earnings release for a foreign private issuer; no special situation is identified.
